description:
Sweep workspace for stale references to the metadata-01 architecture after the rewrite lands.

**What to sweep:**
- AGENTS.md: any references to standalone Metadata/* methods, MetadataBackend trait, or the old type shapes
- bd memories: update or remove memories that reference the old architecture (metadata-server-changes-union-fetch, metadata-server-adopted-canonical-idfate, metadata-types-related-type-optional, metadata-client-errors-rustdoc, memorybackend-change-log-strict-conformance-pattern, method-level-error-ordering, filter-unknown-key-rejection, etc.)
- README files in all 3 metadata crates: update to reflect -02 architecture
- Workspace Cargo.toml: verify crate versions bumped to 0.2.0 (breaking change)
- Any cross-references in sibling crate READMEs or docs that mention standalone Metadata methods

**Depends on:** All other JMAP-ua37 children
title: Clean up stale metadata-01 references in workspace
